body:
three months. i keep coming back to how short this one was 🧣

the Jake Gyllenhaal chapter in our Blank Spaces timeline runs from october 2010 to early january 2011. they were seen together backstage at SNL that october, and by the first days of the new year it was over.

and the timing!! Speak Now came out on october 25, 2010, so the whole chapter sits inside that album's first weeks out in the world.

which chapter do you open first?

critique.rationale: Opens on the feeling about the chapter's length, then two sourced dates and the Speak Now overlap, in first person throughout. Stays on confirmed public history; the photo is a real credited live shot of Taylor, not from 2010.
